analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold but is stabilizing in neutral territory at 60.5. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. Five consecutive daily gains have led to a 6.1% rebound from the 52-week low, yet it remains 10.3% below the 52-week high. The weekly ADX at 16.7 indicates a lack of established trend, with potential for shock-like volatility. The 4-hour RSI is rising at 62.1, but the daily MACD lacks clear direction, warranting a wait-and-see approach.
